summary: High Court sharply criticized the IDF, police and Defense Minister Israel Katz over failures to enable three Palestinian families displaced by extremist settler violence in Jalud to return safely; it ordered security forces to facilitate return/protection within 14 days and issued a conditional order demanding implementation explanations.
notes: High-salience governance/accountability lead. Legal status is an interim/conditional High Court order and judicial criticism, not a final merits finding of personal illegality or misconduct by Katz. Operative return/protection directions reported against IDF/police; Katz was specifically named in the court's criticism. Do not infer motive or personal culpability beyond the documented responsibility link. Corroborated by Reuters reporting that the Supreme Court mandated the return of three displaced Jalud families. Seek the primary court decision and any state/Katz response before canonical acceptance.
